senses.gloss:
mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be feared or apprehended.
E.
भी to fear, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-त्ता-त्त्री-त्तृ)
Who or what divides, disunites, &c.
m. (-त्ता)
1 A divider or separator.
2 A factious or seditious man, a traitor, or one who secretly corresponds with an enemy, &c.
E.
भिद to divide, to sow dissension, aff. तृच्.
